image_description: A white minibus (resembling a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter) parked on a paved street. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of tinted side windows, standard alloy wheels, and a front grille with a visible logo. The background includes residential buildings and palm trees.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from low-profile cars and longer city buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield and a continuous line of dark-tinted side windows are clearly visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The driver's door is visible at the front; the vehicle height is consistent with a standing-height interior.
The vertical seam and handle configuration on the side panel behind the front wheel indicate a sliding door mechanism.
The short hood ahead of the windshield confirms a front-engine layout typical of this class.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the camera frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with grey lower cladding, fitting the 'white' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Wheels are proportionate to the vehicle size and feature realistic rim details.
The window count and body length visually correspond to a 9-12 seat capacity vehicle.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters on the front license plate are illegible and lack distinct alphanumeric structure, appearing as blurred shapes rather than clear text.
The plastic texture on the side mirror appears slightly smoothed and lacks the fine surface detail expected in a photorealistic render.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific make/model consistency and ensure it is not misclassified as a generic van or truck.
To check for spatial grounding errors, specifically ensuring the tires make proper contact with the road and the background buildings have valid depth.
To inspect the boundaries of the windows and doors for any fusion artifacts or edge bleeding into the background.
To rigorously analyze the legibility of the front license plate and any brand badging, which are common failure points.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the license plate; AI often generates gibberish here. Also, verify that the side mirrors are structurally attached to the door/frame and not floating. Check if the reflections in the tinted windows match the surrounding environment logically.
